# TokenCraft

> Free token counter and LLM cost calculator by Nor AI. Paste a prompt to get its token count and what one call, or many calls, costs on 90+ models at OpenRouter list rates. Runs entirely in the browser; prompts are never uploaded.

- Exact counts for OpenAI models (o200k_base and cl100k_base encodings).
- Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, Grok and other models are estimated with o200k_base and labelled "≈ Estimate".
- Prices: OpenRouter's public catalog, refreshed weekly in the build and fetched live when the page opens. List rates in USD; batch discounts excluded.
- Features: token boundaries underlined in the editor, context-window fit including the expected reply, cheapest-model ranking for the exact prompt, prompt minifier with savings counted in tokens.

## Pages

- [Token counter & cost calculator](https://tokens.norai.tech/tools/tokencraft): the tool
- [Per-model pages](https://tokens.norai.tech/sitemap.xml): rate card and worked cost examples for each model
